children: Oklo launched a new at-the-market (ATM) equity distribution program to sell up to $1.0 billion of Class A common stock through a syndicate of sales agents, replacing its prior program terminated on September 10, 2026. Sales may occur on the New York Stock Exchange and other venues at market or negotiated prices, with agent commissions up to 1.5%. Under the terminated agreement, Oklo sold 17,971,448 shares for approximately $1.0 billion in gross proceeds. The new program is designed to provide ongoing, flexible access to capital as market conditions warrant.
